Name: Chara.Chat
Author: ManOfCorn
Description:
[size=4][size=5]Say anything you want to anyone, and get a realistic response using chat AI.[/size][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Walk up to any character in the game and talk to them as normal.[/size]
[*][size=3]Once the the character has no more base game dialogue, the chat window opens.[/size]
[*][size=3]Say anything you want and press enter. The characters will respond![/size]
[*][size=3]Response includes facial expressions[/size]
[/list][/size][size=5]
[img]https://images2.imgbox.com/5b/b6/R9Jts0Q1_o.gif[/img][/size]

[size=2]Please note that, because the online AI chat service that this mod relies on costs money, it will be necessary to buy credits to use this mod. You need to have an [url=https://platform.openai.com/api-keys]OpenAI API key, which you can get here.[/url]﻿ [b]DO NOT SHARE YOUR API KEY WITH ANYONE.[/b] If you do, they will be able to spend money on your behalf. By downloading or using this mod, you agree to indemnify the developers of any and all claims arising from its use, including but not limited to costs incurred.

To use, after installation, you'll have to put your API key in the apiKeys.json file in the mod folder:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iUwGX7c.png[/img]
Chat is [b]unmoderated[/b], although the characters are not likely to say anything offensive. The AI provider does have a [url=https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/moderation#content-classifications]content policy[/url]; it is your responsibility to adhere to it

Code repo is here: [url=https://github.com/tfsJoe/CharaChatSV]https://github.com/tfsJoe/CharaChatSV[/url][/size]
